newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian students protest at Israeli, U.S. policy.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian students protest at Israeli, U.S. policy.

text.p: Thousands of Egyptian students demonstrated at the Azhar Islamic university in Cairo on Monday in protest at Israeli and U.S. policies.

Some of the students burned Israel and U.S. flags but the demonstrators did not leave campus or clash with the riot police surrounding the area, eyewitnesses said. They estimated the size of the crowd at up to 3,000.
Students at Egyptian campuses have been protesting regularly since the Israeli government decided to go ahead with a Jewish settlement at Jabal Abu Ghneim or Har Homa in East Jerusalem.

After similar protests at Cairo University last week, the State Security prosecution on Monday ordered five students detained for questioning for 15 days on suspicion of possessing subversive leaflets and inciting other students to march on the Israeli embassy near the university, security sources said.
Street protests without a permit are illegal in Egypt but students can demonstrate with impunity on campus.
